content.title: 2026 Boston Marathon & Patriot's Day | Route, Schedule
content.text: April 20, 2026 Course Map Marathon Events Where to Watch Where to Carb-load ​Schedule The Boston Marathon is the world’s oldest annual marathon, traditionally held on Patriots' Day, the third Monday of April. The Boston Marathon ranks among the world's best-known road racing events and is one of seven World Marathon Majors. The event attracts 500,000 spectators each year, making it New England's most widely viewed sporting event. What started with 18 participants in 1897 now attracts over 31,000 registered participants each year. For more information on events: baa.org *Map image courtesy of BAA.org Boston Found Podcast The Psychology of Running the Boston Marathon Join us for this week’s episode of Boston Found, as we welcome Boston Marathon’s Former Race Director Dave McGillivray. McGillivray discusses the history behind this historic Marathon, his own journey running, and the unique challenges and incredible sense of accomplishment awaiting those who run the Boston Marathon. More Boston Found podcasts are available on our podcast page or wherever you get your podcasts.
